remarks:
Welcome to 4209 Polly Lane! This charming raised ranch is ready to welcome its next owner. Ideally located near Frontier High School, major shopping, Route 5, Route 20,  Thruway access, and countless everyday conveniences, this home offers both comfort and convenience.
The main level features two bedrooms, an updated full bathroom, a bright eat-in kitchen, and a three-season room that overlooks the backyard. Step outside to a spacious tiered deck with direct access to the above ground pool, all within a fully fenced yard that's perfect for entertaining, relaxing, or enjoying summer with family and friends.
The lower level offers incredible flexibility with a finished space that can serve as a third bedroom, recreation room, home office, gym, or playroom. You'll also find a convenient half bath and laundry/utility area.
Just beyond the lower level is a roughed-in bonus space ready for your vision. Whether you dream of a home bar, additional entertaining area, workshop, storage space, or expanded living area, the opportunity is there to customize it to fit your needs. With so much potential inside and out this home won't last long! Open House Thursday, September 3, 5-7pm.
facts: Eat In Kitchen, Bedroom On Main Level
